message.content:
Here’s a quick snippet that does exactly what you’re looking for:

```python
temp = "hello=good="

# Split on the first '=' only
parts = temp.split('=', 1)

print(parts)   # → ['hello', 'good=']
```

`split('=', 1)` tells Python to split on the first `'='` it encounters, so the remainder of the string (including any subsequent `'='` characters) stays together in the second element.
